title: Foreign Key Cascade Behaviors: CASCADE, SET NULL, and RESTRICT
realWorldScenario: An e-commerce system is designing rules for what happens when a customer account is deleted: what should happen to their past orders and invoices?
questionStatement: Compare `ON DELETE CASCADE`, `ON DELETE SET NULL`, and `ON DELETE RESTRICT` (NO ACTION). What are the business and legal implications of each in e-commerce and financial ledgers?
hints: Can you legally delete past invoices if a user deletes their account?
